_doc: Screen table for driving the original ANNO 1503 (GOG 2.0.0.5). The HUD and construction menu as DATA, so play.py/control.py do not hard-code magic coordinates. Coordinates are WINDOW FRACTIONS (nx, ny in 0..1), exactly as tools/orig/control.py click/move/dbl take them, so they are resolution-independent (the HUD plays at a 1024x768 layout; dgVoodoo2 scales the window). Only coordinates actually measured by running are filled in; everything still to be captured is marked with "capture": "owner-session" and is NOT fabricated. Fill those in an owner-present session (play-original.md stage A acceptance), one screenshot per civilisation level, and commit the numbers.

sources.M: German manual Anno_1503_Manual.pdf (full 77-page) / English game/app/Manual.pdf (39-page); key bindings manual p4-5
sources.mech: docs/re/game-mechanics.md section 1 (key bindings, authoritative from the manual)

rotate_arrows._note: two arrows below the minimap rotate the map

statistics_column._note: below the nameplate: population, balance, goods in/out, military, a per-minute gold balance (red when negative). Exact rows per field: capture.

resource_bar._note: bottom bar, left to right. Exact x per icon: capture.

material_colours.blue: needed for the building in hand

selected_building_panel._note: clicking a placed building replaces the right panel with its / the settlement overview

construction_menu._src: ui-and-placement.md section 2 + playbook.md section 1 (manual). Opened with key B.

categories._note: manual order; on-screen position vs mines/ornamental needs owner confirmation

category_column_y._note: the y fraction of each category icon in the left column (x ~= 0.765). Observed order top-to-bottom (ui-and-placement.md section 2): house, path, ox, anvil, crossed-picks, spear, animal/keg. Record the exact y per category and the true position of coastal/ornamental.

citizen_start_unlocked._src: ui-and-placement.md section 2 (observed; building names read from info panels, not all checked against Anlagen.dat INFRA_EVER)
public: Main market building (1301, 3 tools/7 wood/250 gold)

grid_cells._note: the (nx, ny) of each building's icon in the grid, keyed [category][civ_level][building]. The grid changes with the settlement stage ('?' = not yet unlocked, dark = unlocked soon), so capture once per civ level with the owner. A macro must still check the unlock in the stage mask (city +0x618) before clicking. NOT fabricated here.

menu_navigation._src: ui-and-placement.md section 5 (driven and confirmed by screenshot)

keys._src: game-mechanics.md section 1 (manual p4-5, authoritative, English copy)

panels._note: panel layouts (buttons, sliders, list rows) for the required flows of play-original.md section 4. All capture-by-screenshot in an owner session; sliders are set by drag + read-back from memory, not by a fixed coordinate.

flows: buy (add good; upper slider stock-limit, lower slider price)
sell (upper slider keep, lower slider price)
automatic trade route (route point, 4 actions each, anchor)
treaty status icons CYCLE state -- read before and after, abort on unexpected change
